summary: Caterpillar Financial Services Corp filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $3.25 billion aggregate principal amount of Medium-Term Notes, Series L, in four tranches: $400M floating rate notes due 2028, $750M 4.200% notes due 2028, $1.1B 4.300% notes due 2029, and $1B 4.500% notes due 2031. The notes were issued under a previously filed shelf Registration Statement on Form S-3. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. The filing includes legal opinions and consents. No special-situation mechanics apply.
